caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted dress with long sleeves, rendered in a pale yellow or cream color with a floral pattern featuring small, scattered flowers in shades of pink, blue, and light brown. The dress includes a fitted bodice with vertical seams, a standing collar, and a waistband accentuating the waist. The sleeves are full-length and narrow at the wrists, broadening at the shoulders with a slight puff and layered fabric detail. On the right side of the drawing, there are three smaller line sketches; the top sketch shows the back view of the dress, labeled "Back of Dress," the middle sketch displays a stylized evening bodice with a sweetheart neckline labeled "Evening Bodice," and the bottom sketch presents the back view of the evening bodice labeled "Back of Bodice." The bottom right corner contains handwritten text: "Federal Art Project. W.P.A. of Va. by Mary Humes." The background is plain and off-white.
title: Dress
